fact: Biometric Update reports that the World Bank diagnostic recommends a national interoperability framework for Equatorial Guinea, describing it as currently absent; the date is the article's published date, 2024-07-15.
source_slug: 2024-07-15 World Bank identifies priority actions for DPI in Equatorial Guinea

fact: The World Bank diagnostic states that the government has no national interoperability framework and no government enterprise architecture framework, and that the enterprise architecture is inadequate and incomplete; the document gives only a 2024 publication year, so 2024 is used.

The World Bank diagnostic states that public sector systems do not communicate with each other and that interoperability, where achieved (for example SIGFIP), is ad hoc per ministry without central coordination; the document gives only a 2024 publication year, so 2024 is used.
